modules.goal: build a token bucket rate limiter
modules.rationale: A token bucket rate limiter controls request throughput smoothly while allowing controlled bursts:
modules.code:
import time

class TokenBucket:
    def __init__(self, rate: float, capacity: float):
        self.rate = rate
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.tokens = capacity
        self.timestamp = time.monotonic()

    def allow(self, cost: float = 1.0) -> bool:
        now = time.monotonic()
        self.tokens = min(self.capacity, self.tokens + (now - self.timestamp) * self.rate)
        self.timestamp = now
        if self.tokens >= cost:
            self.tokens -= cost
            return True
        return False

modules.goal: compute principal component analysis (PCA) using numpy SVD
modules.rationale: Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) on mean-centered features yields the top orthogonal principal components cleanly:
modules.code:
import numpy as np

def pca_project(x: np.ndarray, n_components: int) -> np.ndarray:
    centered = x - np.mean(x, axis=0, keepdims=True)
    _, _, vt = np.linalg.svd(centered, full_matrices=False)
    components = vt[:n_components].T
    return centered @ components
